scenes.scene_purpose: Establishing the threat and chaos in the Muggle world

visual_segments.action: Warner Bros logo appears amidst dark clouds. A close-up of an eye opening.
Harry Potter looks forward. Dumbledore appears beside him in a dark room.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Dumbledore's hand on Harry's shoulder

visual_segments.action: Dumbledore places a hand on Harry's shoulder. Harry looks down.

camera.composition_note: Focus on the hand and shoulder

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to exterior of a building

visual_segments.action: Dark clouds swirl above a modern glass building. Reflection of clouds in the glass.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to interior of a cafe

visual_segments.action: People in a cafe look out the window. A man in a suit stands up. A man with glasses holds a cup.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to giant hand in clouds

visual_segments.action: A giant hand made of clouds/smoke forms in the sky. It reaches down towards the city.
Aerial shot of London streets. The giant hand's shadow passes over. People run in panic.
People run through narrow alleys. A man in a coat looks up in fear. Debris falls.
People run across the Millennium Bridge. The bridge begins to twist and collapse.
The bridge collapses into the river. People fall into the water. Aerial view of the destruction.

scenes.scene_purpose: Dumbledore retrieves Harry from the Muggle world

visual_segments.action: Harry sits in a diner reading a newspaper. A waitress walks by. Harry looks up.
Harry smiles slightly, then looks down at the paper. He looks out the window at the rain.
View of the rainy street outside. Harry's reflection is visible in the window. He wipes the condensation.
Dumbledore stands outside in the rain, illuminated by a street light. Harry sees him. Dumbledore enters the station.
Dumbledore puts a hand on Harry's shoulder. They stand on the platform.

scenes.scene_purpose: Dumbledore and Harry visit Horace Slughorn

visual_segments.action: Harry and Dumbledore apparate to a village street. They walk towards a house gate.
They enter a dark, messy house. Dumbledore uses his wand for light. They walk through a hallway.
They enter a room. Dumbledore shines his light around. Harry looks concerned.
Harry looks at a pile of debris. He sees a newspaper with a picture. He looks up at the ceiling.
Dumbledore speaks to Harry. He points his wand at an armchair. The armchair transforms into Slughorn.
Slughorn stands up, looking disheveled. The room begins to repair itself magically. Furniture flies back into place.
The room is now tidy. A chandelier hangs from the ceiling. Harry looks around in amazement.
Harry looks at framed photos on a shelf. Slughorn smiles. Dumbledore and Harry leave the house.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry reunites with the Weasley family

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to exterior of The Burrow

visual_segments.action: Harry and Dumbledore walk out of Slughorn's house gate. They apparate away.
Harry appears in a dark, marshy area. He walks through tall grass towards a lit house.
Harry enters The Burrow. Ginny turns around holding a book. She sees him and smiles.
Harry hugs Ginny. Ron, Hermione, and Mrs. Weasley appear and greet him warmly.

scenes.scene_purpose: Establishing Draco's mission and the state of the wizarding world

visual_segments.action: Aerial view of Diagon Alley. A cloaked figure (Draco) walks down a narrow alleyway between buildings.
Draco knocks on a door. A face appears in the window. He enters Borgin and Burkes.
Inside the dark shop. Narcissa and Bellatrix are present. Snape stands by the bookshelf.
Narcissa looks distressed. Bellatrix watches intently. Snape listens calmly.
Snape takes Narcissa's hand. Bellatrix places her wand over their joined hands. Magic binds them.
Flames wrap around their hands. The vow is sealed. Narcissa looks relieved but sad.

scenes.scene_purpose: Showcasing the twins' success and Harry's purchase

visual_segments.action: Exterior of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes. A giant mechanical hand puts a hat on a head sculpture.
Fred and George stand on a balcony overlooking the busy shop. Customers browse magical items.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione look at products. Fred shows Harry something. Hermione looks at purple flowers.
Close up of cookies baking in an oven. Someone opens the oven door.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry suspects Draco and follows him

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut back to Diagon Alley street

visual_segments.action: Harry, Ron, and Hermione walk down the street. They see Draco enter Borgin and Burkes.
They hide behind a wall. Ron looks through a barred window. Draco is visible inside.
Draco exits the shop. Harry and Ron follow him down a narrow alley.
Draco enters a building. Harry and Ron climb onto a roof to look through a skylight/window.
Harry peers through the glass. He sees Draco talking to someone inside. He looks concerned.

scenes.scene_purpose: Transition to Hogwarts and introduction of new tensions

visual_segments.action: Aerial shot of the Hogwarts Express traveling through the countryside. Steam billows from the engine.
Students walk down the train corridor. Luna Lovegood sells magazines. Harry sits with Ron and Hermione.
Harry, Ron, and Hermione talk in their compartment. The landscape passes by outside the window.
Draco Malfoy enters the compartment. He looks pale and serious. He confronts Harry.
Draco casts a spell. Harry is petrified and falls to the floor. Draco stands over him.
Draco steps on Harry's face briefly, then leaves the compartment. The train continues moving.

scenes.scene_purpose: Students arrive at school; Harry is rescued by Luna

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to train stopping at station

visual_segments.action: The Hogwarts Express arrives at Hogsmeade station at night. Students disembark onto the platform.
Inside the train compartment, Harry lies frozen on the floor. Draco exits the train.
Luna Lovegood enters the compartment wearing her Spectrespecs. She finds Harry on the floor.
Luna waves her wand over Harry. The paralysis breaks. Harry gasps and sits up.
Harry and Luna walk towards the Hogwarts gates. Carriages are waiting. They look up at the castle.

scenes.scene_purpose: Dumbledore announces new staff; sorting ceremony

visual_segments.action: Students sit at long tables in the Great Hall. Dumbledore stands at the podium. Golden eagle statue appears.
Dumbledore introduces Slughorn as the new Potions master. Students applaud. Draco looks bored.
Professor McGonagall brings out the Sorting Hat. First-year students line up. Ron and Harry watch from Gryffindor table.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry discovers the Half-Blood Prince's book

visual_segments.action: Students enter the Potions classroom. Slughorn assigns partners. Harry is paired with Hermione.
Harry opens his old potions textbook. He sees handwritten notes: 'Crush with side of blade'.
Harry crushes the sopophorous bean with a knife instead of cutting it. Pink juice oozes out. He adds it to the cauldron.
Harry's cauldron emits perfect steam. Slughorn inspects it and declares Harry the winner. He gives him Felix Felicis.

scenes.scene_purpose: Dumbledore shows Harry Voldemort's past

visual_segments.action: In Dumbledore's office, Harry holds a vial of memory. Dumbledore gestures to the Pensieve basin.
Harry pours the memory into the basin. Silvery strands swirl. He leans in and falls into the Pensieve.
Harry lands in a green-tinted memory version of London. A younger Dumbledore walks ahead holding an umbrella.
They enter Wool's Orphanage. Young Tom Riddle sits alone by a window. Dumbledore approaches him.
Tom makes objects fly around the room. Dumbledore watches calmly. Tom stares defiantly.
The memory dissolves. Harry pulls back out of the Pensieve, gasping. Dumbledore looks at him seriously.

scenes.scene_purpose: Draco works on the Vanishing Cabinet in the Room of Requirement

visual_segments.action: Nighttime at Hogwarts. Draco walks through dark corridors. He passes a birdcage with a skeleton inside.
Draco paces back and forth in front of a blank wall. A door appears. He enters the Room of Requirement.
The room is filled with junk. Draco approaches the Vanishing Cabinet. He touches it tentatively.
Close up on Draco's face. He looks determined but scared. He begins working on the cabinet.

scenes.scene_purpose: Ron makes the team; Cormac competes

visual_segments.action: Wide shot of the Quidditch pitch. Players in red robes gather. Harry and Ginny stand together watching.
Players take off on brooms. They fly through hoops. Cormac McLaggen flies aggressively.
Ron tries to block goals. He misses some but saves others. Hermione watches from the stands looking worried.
Cormac takes his turn as keeper. He blocks everything effortlessly. He smirks at Ron.
Hermione whispers a spell (Confundus Charm) at Cormac. He gets confused and lets a goal in.
Harry announces the team. Ron is selected as keeper. He beams with joy. Hermione smiles subtly.

scenes.scene_purpose: Establishing romantic subplots and social dynamics

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Gryffindor Common Room interior

visual_segments.action: Harry, Ron, and Hermione sit in the common room. Lavender Brown approaches Ron excitedly.
Lavender kisses Ron passionately. Hermione looks away, visibly upset. Harry watches awkwardly.
Harry stands up and walks away from the couple. He heads towards the stairs.

scenes.scene_purpose: Katie Bell is cursed; foreshadowing danger

visual_segments.action: Students walk through snowy Hogsmeade. Harry, Ron, and Hermione enter the Three Broomsticks pub.
Inside the warm pub. Slughorn is drinking with Madam Rosmerta. They toast. Katie Bell enters looking distressed.
Katie rushes out of the pub clutching a package. Harry notices her strange behavior.
Outside in the snow, Katie screams as the package activates. She levitates uncontrollably into the air.

scenes.scene_purpose: Consequences of the curse; Draco's suspicion grows

visual_segments.action: Katie lies unconscious in a hospital bed. Madam Pomfrey tends to her. Harry, Ron, and Hermione watch worriedly.
Snape enters with McGonagall and Slughorn. He examines the cursed necklace with tongs. It sparkles menacingly.
Snape warns everyone about the necklace's power. McGonagall looks stern. Harry observes Draco's reaction.
Harry stares intently at Draco. Draco avoids eye contact and looks guilty. Harry follows him with his gaze as he leaves.

scenes.scene_purpose: Social maneuvering; Harry uses Felix Felicis

visual_segments.action: Students mingle at Slughorn's party. Red lanterns hang from the ceiling. Harry enters confidently.
Harry approaches Slughorn smoothly. They chat amiably. Slughorn seems impressed by Harry's charm.
Snape corners Harry. He questions him suspiciously. Harry remains calm and deflects.
Slughorn invites Harry to his exclusive 'Slug Club' gathering. Harry smiles triumphantly.

scenes.scene_purpose: Ron's confidence boost before match

visual_segments.action: Great Hall at breakfast. Ron wears his Quidditch gear under his robes. He looks nervous.
Harry secretly pours Felix Felicis into Ron's pumpkin juice. Ron drinks it without noticing.
Ron's demeanor changes instantly. He stands tall, smiling confidently. Hermione looks skeptical.

scenes.scene_purpose: Ron plays perfectly; Gryffindor wins

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Quidditch pitch in snow

visual_segments.action: Quidditch match begins in heavy snow. Players fly aggressively. Ron blocks every shot effortlessly.
Harry spots the Snitch. He dives. The opposing Seeker crashes. Harry catches the Snitch.
Gryffindor wins. Crowd erupts. Ron is lifted onto shoulders. Hermione claps enthusiastically.
Harry lands. He winks at Ron. Ron beams, attributing success to his own skill.

scenes.scene_purpose: Post-match celebration and Ron/Lavender romance

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Gryffindor Common Room party

visual_segments.action: Gryffindor Common Room is packed with celebrating students. Ron stands awkwardly as Lavender hugs him tightly.
Harry smiles watching them but looks slightly uncomfortable. Hermione stands nearby, arms crossed, looking unhappy.

scenes.scene_purpose: Hermione confronts Ron about Lavender; emotional tension

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to dark corridor outside common room

visual_segments.action: Harry walks down a dark stone corridor. He sees Ron and Lavender kissing passionately against a wall.
Hermione storms up the stairs. She sees the couple and stops abruptly. Her face shows hurt and anger.
Ron pulls away from Lavender. He tries to explain to Hermione. Hermione cuts him off sharply.
Hermione turns and runs away down the corridor. Ron looks defeated. Harry watches helplessly.

scenes.scene_purpose: Deepening bond between Harry and Hermione

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to quiet alcove near window

visual_segments.action: Hermione sits alone on a stone ledge by a large window, crying softly. Moonlight illuminates her.
Harry walks over and sits beside her. He doesn't speak immediately, just offers presence.
Hermione leans her head on Harry's shoulder. He puts an arm around her. They sit together in silence.

scenes.scene_purpose: Draco makes progress on his secret mission

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut back to Room of Requirement

visual_segments.action: Draco stands before the Vanishing Cabinet in the dark, cluttered room. He looks exhausted but focused.
Draco places a green apple inside the cabinet. He closes the door and waits anxiously.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry gains access to Slughorn's inner circle

visual_segments.action: Elegant party room with golden drapes. Slughorn introduces Harry to guests. Waiters serve canapés.
Snape enters unexpectedly. He exchanges tense words with Slughorn. Harry watches the interaction carefully.

scenes.scene_purpose: Confirming the Vanishing Cabinet works partially

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut back to Room of Requirement

visual_segments.action: Draco opens the cabinet door. The apple is gone. He looks relieved but also worried. He touches the cabinet gently.

scenes.scene_purpose: Transition; Ginny's message to Harry

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Hogwarts Express exterior in snow

visual_segments.action: Hogwarts Express travels through snowy landscape. Inside, Ginny draws a heart on the foggy compartment window.
Harry and Ron sit opposite each other. Ron talks about Quidditch. Harry looks distracted, thinking.
Ginny finishes drawing 'H + G' in the heart on the window. She smiles at Harry through the glass then walks away.

scenes.scene_purpose: Family warmth contrasted with underlying tension

visual_segments.action: Cozy living room with Christmas tree. Family gathers around table with food. Arthur reads a paper.
Mrs. Weasley brings out a tray of homemade cookies. Harry takes one and eats it gratefully. Ron grabs several.

scenes.scene_title: Death Eater Attack on The Burrow
scenes.scene_purpose: Voldemort's forces attack; Harry defends the Weasleys

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to exterior of The Burrow at night

visual_segments.action: Nighttime outside The Burrow. Shadows move through tall grass. A figure approaches the house stealthily.
Inside, Harry and Ginny stand near stairs. They hear a noise. Harry draws his wand instinctively.
Outside, a ring of fire erupts around the house. Fenrir Greyback runs through the flames towards the door.
Harry casts a spell from inside. Fire explodes outward. Greyback is thrown back but gets up again.
Ginny runs past Harry casting spells. She hits a Death Eater hiding in the grass. The attacker falls.
Multiple dark figures rise from the grass. Harry and Ginny stand back-to-back, wands ready.
Bellatrix Lestrange emerges from the tall grass, laughing maniacally. She points her wand at them.
Sparks fly as Harry and Bellatrix exchange curses. The grass catches fire around them.
The rest of the Weasley family bursts out of the house, wands drawn. They join the defensive line.

scenes.scene_purpose: Aftermath of attack; collective grief

visual_segments.action: Students sit silently at tables in the Great Hall. No food is served. Atmosphere is somber.
Harry walks slowly down the center aisle. He looks exhausted and haunted. Students watch him pass.
Harry sits between Ron and Hermione. None of them speak. They stare blankly ahead. Draco watches from Slytherin table.

scenes.scene_purpose: Learning about Voldemort's obsession with immortality

visual_segments.action: Dumbledore holds another memory vial. He explains its significance to Harry. Harry nods solemnly.
Harry dives into the Pensieve again. The world swirls into green mist. He lands in a dimly lit room.
Teenage Tom Riddle stands before a desk. He asks Dumbledore about Horcruxes. Dumbledore looks grave.
Dumbledore warns Riddle about the dangers of splitting the soul. Riddle smiles coldly, undeterred.
Riddle turns and walks away confidently. Dumbledore watches him go with deep concern.
Harry gasps as he returns to the office. He looks shaken. Dumbledore waits patiently for him to recover.

scenes.scene_purpose: Ron nearly dies; Harry saves him with Bezoar

visual_segments.action: Ron lies unconscious in bed, pale and sweating. Madam Pomfrey checks his pulse frantically.
Harry stands by the bed, panicked. He suddenly remembers the Half-Blood Prince's note about bezoars.
Harry forces a bezoar into Ron's mouth. Ron chokes then swallows. His color begins to return slightly.
Ron opens his eyes weakly. He looks at Harry gratefully. Hermione rushes in, relieved to see him awake.

scenes.scene_purpose: Friends support Ron during recovery

visual_segments.action: Hermione sits beside Ron's bed holding his hand. He looks weak but conscious. Harry stands nearby watching.
McGonagall, Snape, and Dumbledore enter the wing. They discuss the poisoning incident quietly.
Harry gives Hermione space with Ron. He walks towards the exit, looking thoughtful.

scenes.scene_purpose: Draco struggles with his task; emotional breakdown

visual_segments.action: Draco paces frantically in the cluttered room. He runs hands through his hair, looking stressed.
Draco slumps against a pile of junk. He covers his face with his hands. Tears are visible.

scenes.scene_purpose: Draco resumes work despite despair

visual_segments.action: Draco wipes his eyes and stands up. He approaches the Vanishing Cabinet with renewed determination.
Close-up of Draco's hands manipulating intricate carvings on the cabinet door. Sparks fly from his wand.
Draco opens the cabinet. A dead bird falls out instead of disappearing. He stares at it in horror.

scenes.scene_purpose: Social awkwardness post-poisoning

visual_segments.action: Students eat breakfast silently. Ron sits between Harry and Hermione, looking uncomfortable.
Lavender walks over to the Gryffindor table. She looks at Ron expectantly. Hermione stiffens.

scenes.scene_purpose: Draco's isolation increases

visual_segments.action: Draco stands up abruptly from the Slytherin table. He walks quickly towards the exit without eating.
Harry notices Draco leaving. He exchanges a look with Hermione. They both look suspicious.

scenes.scene_purpose: Draco's emotional state deteriorates further

visual_segments.action: Draco sits on the floor of the bathroom, head in hands. He sobs uncontrollably. The room echoes with his grief.

scenes.scene_purpose: Duel in the bathroom; Sectumsempra used

visual_segments.action: Harry enters the bathroom quietly. He sees Draco crying. He draws his wand cautiously.
Draco hears Harry. He spins around, wand raised. His face is tear-streaked and angry.
Harry shouts 'Sectumsempra!'. A jet of light hits Draco. Blood sprays from his chest. He collapses.

scenes.scene_purpose: Snape reveals knowledge of the spell

visual_segments.action: Snape rushes into the bathroom. He kneels beside bleeding Draco. He chants a counter-spell. Blood stops flowing.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry reveals his guilt to friends; emotional resolution

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Gryffindor Common Room at night

visual_segments.action: Harry sits alone by the dying fire in the common room. He stares into the flames, looking tormented.
Ron and Hermione sit down beside him. They don't speak immediately, just offer silent support.
Harry finally speaks, voice trembling. Ron and Hermione listen intently, faces full of concern.

scenes.scene_purpose: Romantic culmination; Harry finds happiness amid darkness

visual_segments.action: Harry enters the cluttered Room of Requirement. Ginny is waiting for him among the junk. They look at each other intensely.
They walk slowly towards each other through the maze of objects. The lighting is soft and golden.
They meet and share a passionate kiss. The camera circles them slowly. Background clutter blurs out of focus.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry obtains the crucial memory using Felix Felicis

visual_segments.action: Harry stands before Slughorn in the common room. He holds the vial of Felix Felicis. He looks determined.
Harry uncorks the vial and drinks the golden liquid in one gulp. His expression shifts to confidence.
Everything seems to align perfectly. Slughorn smiles warmly, completely disarmed by Harry's charm.

scenes.scene_purpose: Brief respite; connection to magical creatures

visual_segments.action: Harry walks up the path to Hagrid's hut. Smoke curls from the chimney. It looks cozy against the grey sky.
Inside, Hagrid tends to plants in pots. He turns and greets Harry with a wide smile.

scenes.scene_purpose: Honoring Hagrid's friend; somber moment

visual_segments.action: On a grassy hill overlooking the lake, a giant spider lies dead. Hagrid stands beside it, weeping openly.
Harry places a hand on Hagrid's massive shoulder. Hagrid leans into the gesture, grateful for the company.

scenes.scene_purpose: The pivotal memory is obtained

visual_segments.action: Inside the hut, Slughorn sits at the table with Hagrid. He looks melancholic but resolved.
Slughorn touches his temple with his wand. A silvery strand of memory emerges. He guides it into a vial.
Slughorn hands the glowing vial to Harry. Their eyes meet. A moment of shared understanding passes between them.

scenes.scene_purpose: Revealing Voldemort's question about Horcruxes

visual_segments.action: Harry pours the new memory into the Pensieve. Dumbledore watches anxiously. The silver liquid swirls violently.
Harry dives in. The world transforms into a green-tinted past. He lands in Slughorn's old office.

scenes.scene_purpose: Confirming Voldemort made seven Horcruxes

visual_segments.action: Young Tom Riddle sits across from young Slughorn. He asks specifically about making seven Horcruxes.
Slughorn looks horrified. He warns Riddle that seven is unnatural. Riddle smiles faintly, satisfied.

scenes.scene_purpose: Processing the revelation

visual_segments.action: Harry gasps as he returns to the office. He looks pale and shaken. Dumbledore waits silently.
Dumbledore nods gravely. He confirms that Voldemort indeed created seven Horcruxes. The weight of this hangs in the air.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry and Dumbledore travel to retrieve a Horcrux

visual_segments.action: A small boat bobs violently on a dark, stormy sea. Harry and Dumbledore stand at the bow, cloaks whipping in the wind.
The boat approaches a massive, jagged cliff face. A dark cave entrance is visible at water level.
They step out of the boat onto wet rocks. Dumbledore leads the way into the darkness. Harry follows closely.

scenes.scene_purpose: Discovering the lake and the island

visual_segments.action: They walk through a cavern filled with glittering ice crystals. The air is cold and still. Dumbledore's wand provides light.
They emerge into a vast underground chamber. A black, still lake stretches before them. An island is visible in the center.
Dumbledore points his wand at the water. A small, ghostly boat rises from the depths. It glows faintly.

scenes.scene_purpose: Tension builds; warning about the water

visual_segments.action: Harry and Dumbledore sit in the spectral boat. It glides silently across the black water. Dumbledore warns Harry not to touch the water.
Harry stares into the water. Pale, skeletal hands suddenly break the surface and grab the side of the boat. He recoils in horror.

scenes.scene_purpose: Dumbledore must drink the emerald potion

visual_segments.action: They step onto the rocky island. In the center stands a stone basin filled with glowing green liquid. A locket rests inside.
Dumbledore reads the inscription on the basin. His face falls. He tells Harry he must drink all of it to get the locket.
Dumbledore scoops up the green potion with a crystal goblet. His hand trembles slightly. He brings it to his lips.

scenes.scene_purpose: Dumbledore suffers greatly; Harry is forced to help

visual_segments.action: Dumbledore drinks. He gasps and shudders violently. He begs for water. Harry looks terrified but compliant.
Harry fills the goblet again from the basin. Dumbledore drinks greedily, then collapses against the rock, moaning.
Dumbledore demands more. Harry forces the last of the potion into his mouth. Dumbledore slumps forward, unconscious or dead.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry gets the Horcrux; realizes it's fake

visual_segments.action: Harry reaches into the empty basin. He pulls out the heavy gold locket. He opens it frantically.
Inside is a folded piece of parchment. Harry reads it. His face falls. It's a message from 'R.A.B.' saying the real locket is gone.

scenes.scene_purpose: The dead rise from the lake

visual_segments.action: The lake begins to churn. Hundreds of pale, bloated corpses (Inferi) rise from the water. They surround the island.
Cold, wet hands grab Harry's ankles. He screams and kicks them away. More Inferi climb onto the rocks.

scenes.scene_purpose: Harry uses fire to repel the Inferi

visual_segments.action: Harry remembers Dumbledore's words about fire. He casts a powerful spell. A ring of fire erupts around the island.
The Inferi shriek and recoil from the heat. They sink back into the water. Harry helps the weakened Dumbledore into the boat.

scenes.scene_purpose: Fleeing the cave as Inferi attack again

visual_segments.action: The boat speeds across the lake. The fire ring behind them flickers and dies. Inferi surge forward again.
Harry casts another fire spell. The entire lake surface ignites. The Inferi are consumed by flames. They escape into the tunnel.

scenes.scene_purpose: Arriving back at school; sense of impending doom

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Hogwarts exterior at night

visual_segments.action: Harry and Dumbledore land on the Hogwarts grounds. The castle looms above them, dark and silent. Dumbledore leans heavily on Harry.
They walk slowly towards the Astronomy Tower. The wind howls. Dark Mark hangs in the sky above the tower.

scenes.scene_purpose: Death Eaters enter Hogwarts via cabinet

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Room of Requirement interior

visual_segments.action: Inside the cluttered room, Draco stands before the Vanishing Cabinet. He looks terrified but resolute. He opens the door.
Dark figures step out of the cabinet one by one. Bellatrix leads them, wand drawn and smiling cruelly.

scenes.scene_purpose: Draco disarms Dumbledore; tension peaks

visual_segments.action: Harry and Dumbledore reach the top of the tower. They are suddenly surrounded by Death Eaters. Draco steps forward, wand shaking.
Draco casts Expelliarmus. Dumbledore's wand flies from his hand. Dumbledore slumps against the railing, weakened from the potion.

scenes.scene_purpose: Snape takes control; fulfills Unbreakable Vow

visual_segments.action: Snape pushes past the other Death Eaters. He walks calmly towards Dumbledore. His face is unreadable.
Dumbledore whispers 'Severus... please.' Snape raises his wand. His expression hardens. Harry watches in horror, paralyzed under Invisibility Cloak.

scenes.scene_purpose: Tragic death of mentor; turning point

visual_segments.action: A jet of green light erupts from Snape's wand. It strikes Dumbledore in the chest. He is thrown backwards over the railing.
Dumbledore's body falls silently through the air. It lands on the grass below. Harry screams but no sound comes out.

scenes.scene_purpose: Chaos spreads; Bellatrix destroys hut

visual_segments.action: On the grounds, Bellatrix laughs maniacally. She casts a spell at Hagrid's hut. Flames erupt instantly.
Harry runs towards the burning hut, screaming Snape's name. He is tackled to the ground by an unseen force.

scenes.scene_purpose: Antagonists escape; Harry left broken

visual_segments.action: Snape stands over the paralyzed Harry. He says nothing, just stares for a moment. Then he turns and walks away into the darkness.
Harry lies on the grass, staring up at the sky. Tears stream down his face. The burning hut illuminates his grief.

scenes.scene_purpose: Collective grief; funeral atmosphere

visual_segments.action: The Great Hall is filled with students and staff in black robes. Silence reigns. Dumbledore's body lies on a bier at the front.
Harry walks slowly down the aisle. He stops beside the bier. He reaches out and gently touches Dumbledore's hand.

scenes.scene_purpose: Tribute to Dumbledore; unity in loss

visual_segments.action: McGonagall stands at the podium. Her voice trembles as she speaks. Students listen with heads bowed.
One by one, students raise their wands. Points of light appear at the tips. The hall fills with glowing stars rising towards the ceiling.

scenes.scene_purpose: Visual metaphor for Dumbledore's legacy

visual_segments.action: The points of light drift upwards like fireflies. They gather near the enchanted ceiling, forming constellations.
Harry looks up at the lights. A single tear falls. He clenches his jaw, resolve hardening in his eyes.

scenes.scene_purpose: Symbolism of loss; passing of torch

visual_segments.action: Dumbledore's office is empty and still. His chair sits vacant. Portraits on the wall look somber.
Harry walks into the office. He runs his hand along Dumbledore's desk. He picks up the Half-Blood Prince book.

scenes.scene_purpose: New leadership established

visual_segments.action: McGonagall enters the office. She looks at Harry with sad pride. She sits in Dumbledore's chair tentatively.
She looks out the window at the lake. Harry stands beside her. They share a moment of silent understanding about the future.

scenes.scene_purpose: Personal sacrifice for greater good

visual_segments.action: Harry and Ginny stand on the balcony overlooking the lake. The sun is setting. Ginny holds the fake locket.
Harry tells Ginny they can't be together. She nods, tears in her eyes but understanding. She hands him back the locket.

scenes.scene_purpose: Setting up the final quest; hope remains

visual_segments.action: Ron walks onto the balcony. He stands beside Harry and Ginny. They look out at the horizon together.
A phoenix flies across the sunset sky. The three friends watch it go. Their silhouettes are framed against the fading light.
